decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY recording that no additional components are required and removing the obsolete updated-BOM artifact request; no further change is necessary.
The source explicitly places the completed wiring plan within this milestone, so the existing same-message MODIFY must also change its persistence to MILESTONE_LOCAL.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hey — I wanted to quickly clarify the scope of this milestone.

Given that the BOM has already been finalized and every part has been purchased and shipped, can you confirm that this milestone is now for the completed system layout and wiring plan, rather than another parts list to purchase from?

I also want to ensure we agree that no further components are required at this stage and that the project is proceeding into the build and integration phase.

Let me know what you think.

decisions.reason: Finalization and purchase of the BOM do not change the approved off-the-shelf component strategy for the first prototype.
The milestone clarification does not change the selected 120V wall-power source.
Proceeding to build and integration does not alter the unit's stability or vibration-control requirements.
The completed-layout milestone clarification does not modify the approved enclosure dimensions or form-factor constraints.
The source changes milestone deliverables and confirms component procurement; it does not alter mixing, frothing, whisk, or high-speed performance requirements.
The milestone clarification does not change the requirement for a removable or readily cleanable dispensing path.
No dispensing mechanism, sequence, flow, or control behavior is changed by the source decision.
The source does not modify the leak-free seal requirements for the bowl or dispensing path.
The milestone and deliverable clarification has no effect on placard wording, placement, or viewing orientation.
Confirmation that no additional components are presently required does not change the approved motor speed range or operating modes.
